_: STUB FIXTURE — install review sheet payload (marketplace §5/§8, ruling R14). Real shape, invented data. Magpie builds gate fixtures from this; Velvet/Fresco build the sheet against it. Every value is a spec token, a count, a boolean or verbatim user content — there is no prose here on purpose, the UI owns wording. Tripwire: tests/review-sheet-fixture.test.ts rebuilds these from a real publish+verify and fails if the shape drifts.

clean._: A free, single-agent preset with nothing alarming in it.
clean._free: FREE is spelled by the ABSENCE of the pricing key — never null. A renderer testing `pricing === undefined` and one testing `'pricing' in payload` must agree.

shellsAndSessions._: The two states the sheet must make loud: shell cards that will run, and a preset that carries the author's conversation. sessions:true is opt-in per R6, so it is a legitimate state the buyer must see, not an error.

verifyFailures._: Tokens the install path can refuse with. The sheet never renders for these — they are the refusal states. Magpie asserts one UI branch per token.

forbiddenReasons._: The 403 vocabulary verbatim (§2 + R11). These are gate answers, not verification failures — different surface, different sheet.
